title: 第17章 斩杀赤发鬼立威舞月婵心动第18章 天骄大战开启唐山初显神威
lines: 场中之人无不惊骇莫名，就连风云韵都是无比诧异的看向顾云。
这是什么手段？
竟然能凭空帮人提高修为？
所谓仙人抚我顶，结发授长生，说的就是这了吧。
怀中的小猫咪更是惊讶无比的看着这一幕，心脏都快要跳出嗓子眼了，这个坏家伙手段竟然是这般神乎其神？
糟糕了，自己还怎么逃出这个恶魔的手掌心？
她向着顾云的怀里面缩了缩，好可怕，要温暖的抱抱。
而受到点化的顾巧儿更是震惊无比，感受着身体的变化，原本淬炼到顶峰的骨骼彻底圆满，同时，自己的血液也开始沸腾起来，这便是踏入炼血境的标志！
“多谢神子殿下！”顾巧儿直接俯身一拜。
顾云却已然飘走。
“不要让我失望。”
在顾巧儿的眉心，顾云还留下了一道术法，一道灵魂冲击，这是最后的保险。
虽然顾巧儿现在是炼血境初期，而唐山不过是炼骨境初期，但是主角毕竟是主角，越级而战是家常便饭。
要想让对方吃瘪，可不是容易的事情。
天骄大比的第一名能得到一枚妖王的妖核，若是唐山得到它，修为就会得到提升，这样子顺应剧本的发展，顾云也不想看到。
看着顾云远去的身影。
顾巧儿呆愣在当场。
顾苍无奈一叹，还真是——一见神子误终身啊，这个劫，得靠顾巧儿自己走出来了。
以他的阅历，怎么会看不出，顾云对顾巧儿没有丝毫的兴趣。
或许是因为施舍、又或者是怜悯，自己等人还是做好本职工作就好。
“公子，那个小妮子好像对你……有点意思。”
飞行途中，风云韵传音给顾云道。
“哦？是吗？”顾云淡淡回应。
“公子对她不感兴趣吗？”
“不是所有人都能入我的眼。”
顾云不再回应。
但是这话语却让风云韵心中小鹿乱撞，不是所有人都能入公子的眼？
可公子却愿意顺从自己，还千里迢迢将自己解救。
若没有公子，当时在紫云山脉，自己根本不敢想象接下去会发生什么事情。
【叮！风云韵彻底倾心，宿主完成反派行径——气运之女收割机（lv1），获得反派值1000】
听闻着这个提示音，顾云还是不免觉得舒服。
果然，英雄救美加上悉心呵护，是很容易长好感的，当然顾云从来懒得刻意做这些事情，一切都只是他的行为习惯而已，霸道也好、温柔也罢，他想怎么做，就怎么做。
系统也干涉不了。
两人很快来到了看台之上，五大势力汇聚之地。
“何人？！”赤霄剑阁的赤发鬼怒喝一声，站起身，看向不速之客出现的方向。
content_en:
Everyone in the field was shocked and inexplicable, even Feng Yunyun looked at Gu Yun in great surprise.
What method is this?
Can you actually help people improve their cultivation out of thin air?
The so-called immortal touches my head and knots my hair to grant immortality. This is what it means.
The little kitten in his arms looked at this scene in great surprise, and his heart almost jumped out of his throat. How could this bad guy be so miraculous?
Too bad, how can I escape from the clutches of this devil?
She shrank into Gu Yun's arms, it was so scary and she wanted a warm hug.
Gu Qiaoer, who received the enlightenment, was even more shocked. He felt the changes in his body. The bones that had been tempered to the peak were completely perfect. At the same time, his blood began to boil. This was a sign of entering the blood refining realm!
"Thank you, His Highness the Son of God!" Gu Qiaoer leaned over and paid homage.
Gu Yun had already drifted away.
"Don't let me down."
In the center of Gu Qiaoer's eyebrows, Gu Yun also left a spell, a soul shock, which was the final insurance.
Although Gu Qiaoer is currently at the early stage of the Blood Refining Realm, and Tangshan is only at the early stage of the Bone Refining Realm, the protagonist is the protagonist after all, and fighting across levels is commonplace.
It is not easy to make the other party suffer.
The first place in the Tianjiao Competition can get a Demon King's Demon Core. If Tangshan gets it, his cultivation level will be improved. This conforms to the development of the script, and Gu Yun doesn't want to see it.
Looking at Gu Yun's retreating figure.
Gu Qiaoer was stunned on the spot.
Gu Cang sighed helplessly, it was true - he lost his life when he saw the Son of God. It was up to Gu Qiaoer to get out of this calamity.
With his experience, how could he not see that Gu Yun had no interest in Gu Qiaoer at all.
Maybe it was charity or pity, so I and others should just do their jobs well.
"Sir, that little girl seems to be... a little interested in you."
During the flight, Fengyun Yun sent a message to Gu Yundao.
"Oh? Really?" Gu Yun responded lightly.
"Master, aren't you interested in her?"
"Not everyone can catch my eye."
Gu Yun stopped responding.
But these words made Feng Yunyun's heart tremble. Not everyone can fall into the eyes of the young master?
But the young master was willing to obey him and went all the way to rescue him.
If it weren't for Young Master, I couldn't imagine what would happen next in the Ziyun Mountains.
【bite! Fengyun Yun is completely smitten, and the host completes the villain's act - the Harvester of Luck (lv1), and obtains the villain value of 1000]
Hearing this prompt, Gu Yun couldn't help but feel comfortable.
Sure enough, it's easy to fall in love with a hero who saves a beauty and takes good care of her. Of course, Gu Yun never bothers to do these things deliberately. It's just his behavioral habits. Whether he is domineering or gentle, he can do whatever he wants.
The system cannot interfere.
The two people quickly arrived at the grandstand, where the five major forces gathered.
"Who?!" The red-haired ghost from Chixiao Sword Pavilion shouted angrily, stood up, and looked in the direction where the uninvited guest appeared.
title_en: Chapter 17: Killing the red-haired ghost shows his power and dances with Yue Chan. Chapter 18: The war of genius begins and Tangshan shows its power for the first time.
